entries.headline: Colson Montgomery connected at +330
entries.story: Colson Montgomery cashed. Facing Nick Martinez, he went deep in the 6th in his 3rd at bat. The call: "Colson Montgomery homers (25) on a fly ball to right field. Munetaka Murakami scores." Final line: 1-for-4.

entries.headline: Eugenio Suárez stayed in the yard
entries.story: Eugenio Suárez went 0-for-3 with 1 BB against Paul Skenes and the Pittsburgh Pirates. No real scare on the HR front, striking out 2 times.
